skills.name: Swaying Bell
skills.description: Follow me closely. SP Kochou attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK. Level 2: 105%. Level 3: 110%. Level 4: 115%. Level 5: 125%.

skills.name: Spiritual Dream
skills.description: I see it — the dream’s continuation. When affected by Sleep, she cocoons herself and casts this skill instead. Gains a Dream Cocoon equal to 15% of max HP for 2 turns (uncleansable shield, +10% damage dealt). Level 2: Cocoon 20%. Level 3: immune to excess damage when Cocoon breaks. Level 4: casts automatically when cumulative damage exceeds 20% of max HP (once before her next turn). Level 5: Cocoon bearer’s damage dealt +20%.

upgrades.text: When Dream Cocoon is broken, immune to excess damage.
In any turn, when cumulative damage taken exceeds 20% of max HP, casts Spirit Dream. (Up to once before their next turn.)
Increases Dream Cocoon bearer's damage dealt by 20%.

skills.name: Sound of Dreams
skills.description: Now, I can shine brightly on stage too. Heals all allies for 15% of their max HP, 20% for the selected target. Level 2: selected target 30%. Level 3: all allies’ damage +20% for 1 turn. Level 4: grants the target a Dream Cocoon equal to 50% of healing received (2 turns). Level 5: Upper Hand — casts on the allied shikigami with the highest initial ATK.
skills.line: Now, I can shine brightly on stage too.

upgrades.text: Increases healing on selected target to 30%.
Using the skill additionally increases all allies' damage by 20% for 1 turn.
Grants the selected target a Dream Cocoon equal to 50% of healing received for 2 turns.
Upper Hand: Effective exclusively, casts on the allied shikigami with the highest initial ATK.
